page_title: LEV 3-0 BAY | Bayer Leverkusen v Bayern Munich 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+5' 3 - 0 Manuel Neuer tries in vain to get back after he went up for that corner with time running out, but can only watch in horror as Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) takes aim and sends the ball into the unguarded net from distance. 3:0.
90+5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+3' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayern Munich will take a free kick near the side line.
90+2' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Alejandro Grimaldo is replaced by Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen).
90' Substitution. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) has come on for Florian Wirtz.
90' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
89' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
87' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
85' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
84' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
83' Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amine Adli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
81' Here is a change. Jamal Musiala is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
81' Substitution. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) on for Sacha Boey.
81' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but it's cleared.
79' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
77' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
76' 12:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
75' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick.

73' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

72' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Felix Zwayer saw the whole situation. Free kick. Bayer Leverkusen will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
72' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).
71' That will be all from Leon Goretzka who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
71' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
70' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
70' The attendance is 30210.
70' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick.

67' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
67' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Nathan Tella.
64' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Lukas Hradecky.
64' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

63' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
60' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Aleksandar Pavlovic and he is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
60' It will be a substitution. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is ready to enter the pitch as Dayot Upamecano walks off.
59' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Manuel Neuer, who makes a comfortable save.
58' A spell of possession for Bayer Leverkusen in an attempt to control the game.
56' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' The corner kick from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

55' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) attempts to release Harry Kane with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Bayern Munich are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
50' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Nathan Tella feeds Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top left corner.
49' Bayern Munich are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
47' Bayer Leverkusen are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Rough tackle by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for holding. Felix Zwayer signals a set piece. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
43' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
42' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

41' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
40' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
37' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) failed to beat Manuel Neuer, who expertly stopped his header from the centre of the box towards the roof of the net after a rebound.
37' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
36' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
35' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Dangerous play by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
32' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dayot Upamecano, but he can't get on the end of the pass. It's a throw-in for Bayer Leverkusen.

30' Bayer Leverkusen players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is behind the touchline and Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.

29' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Zwayer no option but to blow his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
28' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
27' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot.

26' The game is interrupted. Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Bayern Munich get a free kick.
26' Bayern Munich try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.

26' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Felix Zwayer blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Bayern Munich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
25' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
24' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

24' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
23' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take a corner kick.

23' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Manuel Neuer pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.

23' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
21' A player from Bayern Munich commits a rough challenge. Felix Zwayer blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.

18' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Robert Andrich, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Manuel Neuer with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:0.
18' A neat pass is well received by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
17' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
16' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Florian Wirtz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' A pass from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayer Leverkusen.

13' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.

11' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
10' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
9' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) tries to find Sacha Boey, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
6' Bayern Munich showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a throw-in.
5' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bayern Munich.
4' The ball is cleared after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Bayer Leverkusen are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
2' Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The match has just started.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
Felix Zwayer will supervise the game today.
